response.query: Which prior empirical studies and theoretical frameworks do you cite to justify RHaT mechanisms (meaning-making, coherence, agency) and the chosen primary and mediator outcomes?
response.answer: RHaT mechanisms are supported by studies on meaning-making and coherence in narrative identity, and frameworks on agency in self-regulation. Primary outcomes include well-being, while mediator outcomes focus on psychological resilience.

results.title: Words
results.content: Nicola Braghieri, Daniel will consider questions of craft in a contemporary and increasingly digital building culture, through a number of DRDH’s completed and ongoing projects alongside work from his Chair at TU Delft. Daniel will be giving a lecture on 5 March 2024 as part of Norwich University of the Arts’ Architecture & Interior Design Studio Talks series. Exhibition — Small Projects Awards, The Building Design Centre, London Gallery, London Metropolitan University Lecture — DRDH, Work, University of Greenwich, Department of Architecture, London Lecture — DRDH, Making Time Building Design, Young Architects Lecture Series, London Prior to starting DRDH, Daniel worked for Priestman Architects in London and Scandinavia, coordinating a competition team for a series of high profile international competitions including first prize for the Danish State Archive. Jakub Kolodziejak joined DRDH in 2019 as a Part 1 Architectural Assistant after graduating from The School of Art, Architecture and Design at London Metropolitan University where he was nominated for the RIBA Bronze Medal.
